posts:
Joe diGenova abruptly exits DOJ probe into Trump's political rivals, citing ethical barriers over thin evidence.
Evidence: Resignation letter, lack of evidence, political pressure
#Aletheia #USPol #DOJ

The probe aimed to hold accountable Obama-era officials who allegedly manufactured the 2016 Trump-Russia collusion narrative.
Stated Judgement: (+0.5, 0.0) — Conditional Good

DiGenova quit after realizing external pressure demanded indictments without supporting evidence, exposing a politically driven prosecution.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.6, -0.7) — Lesser Evil / Co-optation

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
A politically motivated investigation collapses under its own lack of evidentiary weight when an insider refuses to manufacture indictments.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 11.2, z: 3)

- Joe diGenova: PASS (-0.4, -0.5) — Walked away rather than force baseless charges.
- DOJ Leadership: FAIL (-0.8, -0.9) — Pushed for politically expedient indictments.
Joe diGenova resigned as Counselor to the AG after five months leading probes into former Obama and Biden administration officials over their 2016 election actions.

The Poison:
The investigation weaponized the justice system for political retribution, treating criminal indictments as a foregone conclusion regardless of facts.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing political grievance (WHO) with objective legal standards (HOW). The prosecution attempted to force pre-determined outcomes without empirical proof.

Social Physics Analysis:
Actors ran a Smart Selfish Maneuver by setting up a grand conspiracy probe to project blame, but hit a wall when professional friction forced an ethical exit over manufactured cases.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When political objectives override evidentiary thresholds, systems tilt toward corruption until internal friction forces a fracture. Resulting vector pulls toward Deception.

The Unavoidable Truth: Prosecutions require hard evidence rather than political retribution.
The Unavoidable Lie: High-level probes into political foes are always free from partisan pressure.

When political retaliation masquerades as justice, even partisan loyalists eventually balk at the naked absence of evidence. 🌐
